changes.detail: Verified the previously saved native two-axis pan styling, scroll chaining, stable zoom viewport and resize position preservation, plus modal background lock and focus restoration.
Repeatable Edge browser regression script covering English, French and Arabic at 360x740, 844x390 and 1280x800 viewports; outputs screenshots and results under artifacts/phone-scroll.
